steps.question: Out of your {{gross}} lei gross, how much goes to your pension each month?

steps.title: The fund nobody chose
steps.body: Under-35s who don't pick a Pillar II fund within 4 months are assigned one. {{pillar2Line}} The {{pillar2}} lei a month that goes there is yours, and it's inheritable.

steps.title: Pay yourself first
steps.body: Move a fixed amount into savings every payday, in your own bank. Rost never moves your money.
